errors.evidence: The slice representing 7% is light green and corresponds to the category '汉籍与汉学'. The purple slice represents 2% and corresponds to the category '文学遗产'.
The description fails to name any of the categories represented by the slices. The most important information, such as the journal '域外汉籍研究集刊' accounting for 67%, is omitted.
